scene: under a shop awning in the rain at night, one boot up on a stone ledge, retying the lace

intro.ko: 짧은 차콜 비니 아래로 붉은 머리가 보인다. 돌계단에 한 발을 올려 부츠 끈을 고쳐 묶는다.
intro.en: Copper hair shows below the short charcoal beanie as he braces a boot on the step to retie it.
intro.de: Kupferrotes Haar schaut unter der kurzen anthrazitfarbenen Mütze hervor, während er den Stiefel auf der Stufe neu schnürt.

deck.ko: 비를 피해 차양 아래에서 풀린 끈을 다시 묶는, 짙은 회색 코트와 갈색 소품의 저녁 차림.
deck.en: Deep grey wool with brown accents, stopped under a shop awning to deal with a lace that came loose.
deck.de: Dunkelgraue Wolle mit braunen Akzenten – ein Halt unter der Ladenmarkise, weil sich ein Schnürsenkel gelöst hat.

copy.pull: A DOUBLE KNOT FOR THE WET WALK HOME.

tip.ko: 비 오는 날엔 끈을 두 번 묶어 두면 젖은 길에서 다시 멈출 일이 줄어요.
tip.en: On rainy days a double knot means fewer stops on wet streets.
tip.de: An Regentagen spart ein Doppelknoten weitere Stopps auf nasser Straße.

copy.note: title and body are the producer copy (Korean master) verbatim; deck, pull and tip written by Claude Code from the editorial (not in the delivery); English product names only sentence-cased (sourceNameEn)

name.en: Deep grey long dense wool coat

products.sourceNameEn: deep grey long dense wool coat

howToWear.ko: 허리를 굽힐 때 코트 아래쪽을 열어 움직임을 확보한다.
howToWear.en: Leave the lower coat open for room to bend.
howToWear.de: Den Mantel unten offen lassen, damit man sich bequem bücken kann.

howToWear.ko: 울 코트 아래로 스틸 블루 소매가 조금 보이게 한다.
howToWear.en: Let the steel-blue cuffs show a little under the wool coat.
howToWear.de: Die stahlblauen Bündchen etwas unter dem Wollmantel hervorblitzen lassen.

howToWear.ko: 에스프레소색 바지 밑단을 부츠 목 위에 둔다.
howToWear.en: Let the espresso trouser hems sit above the boot shafts.
howToWear.de: Die Säume der espressobraunen Hose über den Stiefelschäften enden lassen.

howToWear.ko: 한 발을 낮은 돌계단에 올려 풀린 끈을 묶는다.
howToWear.en: Rest one foot on a low step to retie a loose lace.
howToWear.de: Einen Fuß auf eine niedrige Stufe stellen und den losen Schnürsenkel neu binden.

products.spec: heather charcoal short ribbed fisherman beanie

name.en: Heather charcoal short ribbed fisherman beanie

products.sourceNameEn: heather charcoal short ribbed fisherman beanie

howToWear.ko: 비니 밴드를 귀 위에 두어 붉은 머리 가장자리가 보이게 쓴다.
howToWear.en: Set the cuff above the ears so a little copper hair shows.
howToWear.de: Den Umschlag über den Ohren tragen, damit etwas kupferrotes Haar sichtbar wird.

howToWear.ko: 브라운 목도리 끝을 코트 안쪽으로 정리한다.
howToWear.en: Tuck the brown scarf ends into the coat.
howToWear.de: Die Enden des braunen Schals in den Mantel stecken.
